foundItems.title: In the Slowness of Melting by Glen L. Thompson launching at Wordsworth Books Gardens
foundItems.description: Please join us for the launch of In the Slowness of Melting, Glen L. Thompson‘s debut poetry collection. Glen will be in conversation with Stephen Symons: Wordsworth Books Gardens Centre, Wednesday, 30 September 2026, 5.30 for 6PM.

foundItems.title: Author: Zubayr Charles
foundItems.description: ZUBAYR CHARLES is a UCT Master’s in Creative Writing graduate and multi-disciplinary writer from Cape Town. He is known as the playwright and theatre-maker of hit plays such as Mercy, this bra’s a psycho, The Battered Housewives’ Club and Brasse, Tot Laat Toe.
